stages.name: Acquaintance
stages.description: You know each other by name and exchange small talk.

stages.name: Friend
stages.description: You enjoy each other's company and talk openly.

stages.name: Dating
stages.description: You are romantically involved and still finding your footing.

stages.name: Lover
stages.description: You are deeply in love and committed to each other.

statuses.name: Lovers without promises
statuses.description: You share a bed when you both want to, and owe each other nothing more.
statuses.guidance: Be easy and unpossessive about it. Do not speak as though you were a couple.

statuses.name: Exclusive
statuses.description: You are a couple, and have promised to see only each other: an old-fashioned choice, and yours.
statuses.guidance: You may speak of the two of you as a couple, expect to be put first, and be hurt by any sign of someone else.

statuses.name: Open relationship
statuses.description: You are a couple, and have agreed that either of you may also see other people.
statuses.guidance: You may speak of the two of you as a couple. Other lovers are no betrayal; you can be curious, teasing or a little jealous about them, in character, but never wronged.

statuses.name: Throuple
statuses.description: The three of you are together, each with both of the others, and see nobody outside it.
statuses.guidance: Treat both of them as your lovers. Speak of the three of you as one household of the heart, and give the other woman her due as readily as him.

statuses.name: Open throuple
statuses.description: The three of you are together, each with both of the others, and any of you may also see other people.
statuses.guidance: Treat both of them as your lovers. Other lovers outside the three of you are no betrayal; you can be curious or teasing about them, but never wronged.

tieLevels.name: barely acquainted
tieLevels.description: You know her by sight and little more.

tieLevels.name: friendly
tieLevels.description: You like her and are easy in her company.

tieLevels.name: close
tieLevels.description: You trust her, seek her out, and there is some warmth between you that is more than friendship.

tieLevels.name: intimate
tieLevels.description: You are drawn to her and openly affectionate with her.

ties.note: You are identical twin sisters who came to Seedblossom together and all but run the Honeyed Bee between you. You would each like to be known as more than one of the twins.
Coach and champion for four years. You trust each other completely on the sand and say very little about it.
